source.provenance: Generated from local retrieval scoring artifacts and a local token-metered replay. Raw run artifacts stay local and are intentionally not part of this public summary.
source.boundary: The full run artifacts are local evidence. This checked-in summary is the public artifact for the 500-check practical case study: 400 retrieval/resource checks plus 100 token-metered context-consumption checks. It does not make winner, leaderboard, research-paper benchmark, token-savings, resource-efficiency, or patch-quality claims.

appendixOnlyTools.reason: bounded local indexing readiness failed earlier; not part of this five-tool headline table

methodology.notMeasured: patch correctness, developer productivity, token savings in a patch workflow, model-provider bill, research-paper repeat confidence intervals
methodology.scoring: official ContextBench evaluator on saved retrieval trajectories using per-task gold; scorer gold was not read during retrieval
methodology.measured: retrieval overlap, setup/index time, elapsed check time, process memory telemetry, GPU availability probe, failed checks, and context-consumption token usage on a 100-check metered replay
methodology.metricView: failure-inclusive means; judge_failed/no_context checks count as zero in the public summary
methodology.publicFrame: we benchmarked these tools on open-source repos

perToolRuntimeTokenAccounting.claimImpact: Per-tool context-consumption token cost is now reported for 20 metered checks per tool. Token-savings and model-provider pricing claims remain blocked because this is not a full patch workflow and pricing was not calculated.

failedChecks.reason: 12 no_context_extracted checks in the 300-check repeat run plus 1 judge_failed/no_context check in the corrected 100-check run
failedChecks.publicTreatment: Retained in the denominator and counted as zero in failure-inclusive public averages

interpretation: jCodeMunch slightly leads the aggregate retrieval metrics and indexed much faster in this adapter run.
codebase-context is close on file/span/line retrieval but paid a high local Transformers indexing cost.
context-mode is lightweight and low-cost, with lower expected-file coverage in this run.
Repowise produced usable checks, but it retained 13 checks with no usable context and had the highest observed memory footprint.
raw-native is the simple local file-search baseline here; it had low retrieval overlap on these 20 tasks.

caveats.publicDocs: passed: README/docs/package-facing benchmark wording is aligned to the practical 500-check case-study framing
caveats.overclaiming: passed: public wording keeps winner, leaderboard, research-paper benchmark, resource-efficiency, patch-quality, and productivity claims blocked
caveats.patchQuality: blocked: retrieval-overlap only, no downstream patch/test success measured
caveats.costAccounting: partial_pass: setup/index/resource telemetry captured; 100 context-consumption token checks captured; model-provider costs and patch-workflow token savings remain unmeasured
caveats.repeatStability: blocked: 500-check view combines local evidence sets; no research-paper stability or confidence claim
caveats.artifactCompleteness: passed: 400 checks have retrieval and scoring artifacts in local evidence; 100 metered checks have usage counters; checked-in summary is the public boundary
caveats.failureInclusion: passed: Repowise checks with no usable context are retained and zero-filled metric view exists
